none: PAS YORYM-2902A4: Roman Coin : Radiate of Allectus
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy radiate of Allectus (AD 293-6) (Reece Period 14), PROVID AVG reverse type depicting Providentia standing left holding globe and transverse sceptre. Mint of London, S P//ML. RIC V pt.2, p.562, cf. no.38var. The obverse legend is probably a variant, but the overall style of the coin suggests it might be irregular. This coin is included in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
